edits: add one F on the distal pyrazine
proposals.hypothesis: Tetra-aza D05 core gave margin 0.18 with f 1.07 and no detachment, so extra ring N is a margin lever. A single pyrazine F raised f in the D05 series (1.09 to 1.24) while moving margin up. Combining them tests whether f rises while margin stays above 0.15. Pyrazine-side halogens kept f, unlike quinone-ring halogens, which cut f (F2 0.77, Cl2 0.65). Avoids CN, which detached (D03/D07/D12). K123/K124 support strong binding in the quinoxalinedione class.

The tetra-aza core gave the best margin and f pair so far (0.18, 1.07). Remote F2 on the far pyrazine adds withdrawal, as in D19 where pyrazine-side F2 raised f from 0.86 to 0.97. Fluorination far from the carbonyls should keep the CO2 binding at the quinone O atoms (K084 shows F-quinones bind CO2). Tests whether margin can grow without the f loss seen for quinone-ring halogens. Avoids CN.

edits: add a single Cl on the pyrazine ring, quinone C=C-H left unsubstituted
proposals.hypothesis: Mono-F on the pyrazine gave f 1.24 and margin 0.03. Pyrazine Cl2 gave margin 0.17 but f 0.89. Cl is the stronger margin lever per atom and a single halogen is the smaller f penalty (D08 to D18 to D13 shows f falls with halogen count). One Cl should land between the two and may give f above 1.2 with margin near 0.1. Cl-quinones show CO2 binding (K008, K056). No CN, no amino/OH, which lowered f in D01/D04/D06.

edits: move one Cl of 2,6-dichloro-p-benzoquinone to give the 2,5-dichloro isomer
proposals.hypothesis: D08 is the only benzoquinone with f above 1 (1.04), margin 0.097, and f falls as halogens are added (D18 0.63, D13 0.22). Keeping two Cl but moving them to the 2,5 positions (K020 is a measured dichloro-BQ with binding constant 8e5) changes the field symmetry across both carbonyls and may raise margin without adding halogens. A positional test of the halogen-count rule; it avoids the f loss from more halogens and any CN group.

edits: replace the pyrazine with a pyridine ring (quinoline-5,8-dione core)
add one F on the pyridine ring
proposals.hypothesis: D05 f comes from the ring N next to the carbonyl (bind -27.6). Keeping one N but adding F tests whether a lighter heteroaryl with a single remote F gives f near the 1.24 of the mono-F pyrazine. D10 vs D21 shows ring N adds margin without detachment, and K110 shows a high binding constant for the N-heterocyclic dione. A single pyridine F is far from the carbonyls and adds withdrawal without the quinone-ring halogen f penalty.
